members.comment:
--- HMI ----------------------------------------------------------------
 One struct for the whole tile, extending the SPT module interface. The
 inherited half is bridged to the base's own PackMLBaseModule_HMI in two
 places: HMICommunication pushes Command in before the base acts on it,
 PublishHMI copies Config and Status back out after. The Station half is this
 block's own and is filled by PublishHMI alone.
members.name: HMI

The physical operator panel, H_ControlPanel. A second control source rather
 than a device: FB_ControlSource already owns the START/STOP/RESET ladder,
 and MAX_NO_OF_EXTERNAL_CONTROLLERS is an array, so the two coexist.
